name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Faces Crucial Hurdle Ahead of Confirmation as Attorney General
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination is broadly a referendum on President Trump’s vision of the Justice Department as a projection of his power.

changes.title: Watch Live: Jay Clayton, Trump
changes.summary: Clayton, currently the U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York, is expected to succeed Bill Pulte, Trump.

changes.title: US Resumes Hormuz Blockade as Trump Threatens More Strikes
changes.summary: The United States is escalating its attacks on Iran, striking military targets including coastal defense systems and missile and drone sites. It comes as President Donald Trump in an interview warned that the U.S. will begin striking civilian infrastructure including energy targets unless Iran agrees to negotiate. NBC’.

changes.title: Trump's intelligence head pick Jay Clayton gives opening statement at Senate committee hearing
changes.summary: Trump's pick for director of national intelligence, Jay Clayton, addressed the Senate Intelligence Committee before his confirmation hearing on Tuesday.

changes.title: Sen. Whitehouse clashes with Todd Blanche over his relationship with Trump: "It takes 2 to collude"
changes.summary: Rhode Island Democratic Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse slammed Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche during his confirmation hearing over his relationship with President Trump, accusing the pair of colluding.

changes.title: ICE Halts Most Vehicle Stops After Fatal Texas, Maine Shootings
changes.summary: In the wake of two fatal ICE-involved shootings in less than a week, the Department of Homeland Security is now instructing agents to suspend most vehicle stops amid growing uproar. On Truth Social, President Donald Trump wrote, “We cannot give up one of ICE’s most important and effective crime fighting tools,” adding,.

changes.title: ICE should continue traffic stops despite recent shootings, Trump says on social media
changes.summary: Trump wrote that "we must be strong, tough and smart and we CANNOT give up one of ICE's most important and effective Crime Fighting tools, THE TRAFFIC STOP!".

changes.title: Sen. Schiff and Blanche argue about conflicts of interest, Trump's IRS settlement
changes.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff and acting Attorney General Todd Blanche argued over President Trump's IRS settlement during Blanche's Senate confirmation hearing on Wednesday. See the exchange.

changes.title: Trump relished in being compared to dictators like Hitler and Stalin, journalist says
changes.summary: The New York Times journalist Jonathan Swan says the president is fixated on becoming a "great man of history" during his second term. Swan's new book, written with Maggie Haberman, is Regime Change. (Image credit: Jacquelyn Martin).

changes.title: China and Xi favored over US and Trump in many nations: Survey
changes.summary: The change is driven by improved perceptions of China and declining views of the United States. (Image credit: Mark Schiefelbein).
